title: OK Go - Here It Goes Again
description: The iconic treadmill dance choreography video — pure creative joy.

title: OK Go - This Too Shall Pass (Rube Goldberg Machine)
description: A massive Rube Goldberg machine set to music. Engineering meets art.

title: OK Go - Upside Down & Inside Out
description: Music video filmed in zero gravity on a parabolic flight.

title: Marcel the Shell with Shoes On
description: A tiny shell with shoes tells us about his life. Charming, funny, and heartfelt.

title: Marcel the Shell with Shoes On, Two
description: Marcel returns with more observations about his tiny life.

title: Marcel the Shell with Shoes On, Three
description: The third Marcel the Shell short — still wonderful.

title: Iguana vs Snakes — Planet Earth II
description: A baby iguana's heart-pounding dash past racer snakes. One of the greatest nature sequences ever filmed.

title: Kurzgesagt — The Immune System Explained
description: Beautiful animation explaining how your body fights off invaders.

title: Vsauce — How Much Does a Shadow Weigh?
description: Michael Stevens takes a simple question on a wild, mind-bending journey.

title: How the food you eat affects your brain
description: Animated explainer on how different nutrients affect brain function.

title: Mark Rober — Glitter Bomb Trap
description: An ex-NASA engineer builds an elaborate glitter bomb to catch porch pirates.

title: How To Cook That — Debunking Viral Food Hacks
description: Ann Reardon tests whether viral cooking hacks actually work. Spoiler: most don't.

title: Bill Nye The Science Guy — Volcanoes
description: Classic Bill Nye episode explaining how volcanoes work.

title: Pentatonix - Daft Punk (Official Video)
description: A dazzling a cappella medley that shows older children how far musical arrangement, rhythm and vocal layering can go without ever feeling crude or disposable.

title: Cello Wars (Star Wars Parody) Lightsaber Duel - The Piano Guys
description: A parent-friendly showpiece that blends film music, slapstick and virtuoso cello playing in a way that lands with both younger kids and teens.

title: 5 People 1 Guitar!
description: A fantastically rewatchable collaboration video that makes musical teamwork itself feel like the spectacle.

title: Fresh Guacamole by PES | Oscar Nominated Short
description: A tiny masterclass in visual imagination that turns ordinary objects into absurdly clever stop-motion 'ingredients' kids instantly want to replay.

title: Western Spaghetti by PES | The FIRST Stop-Motion Cooking Film
description: A wonderfully inventive short that makes animation, object substitution and timing feel magical even to children who think they do not care about art.

title: The Joy of Books
description: A charming stop-motion celebration of physical books that quietly sells reading, craftsmanship and patience without ever feeling preachy.

title: Whales' Bubble Net Fishing | Nature's Great Events | BBC Earth
description: An awe-heavy wildlife clip that shows real animal co-operation on a scale children rarely forget after the first watch.

title: Bird Of Paradise Courtship Spectacle | Planet Earth | BBC Earth
description: A visually astonishing courtship display that feels almost unreal and is excellent for kids who love colour, movement and animal behaviour.

title: Animal Attack! Baby Sea Turtles | National Geographic
description: A dramatic but still classroom-usable wildlife clip that gives older children a vivid sense of how hard survival is in the natural world.

title: Cat Man Do | 4K Remastered | Simon's Cat Extra
description: A near-perfect silent-comedy short for younger viewers, with gags parents tend to enjoy just as much as the children do.

title: Let Me In! - Simon's Cat
description: Another clean silent-comedy gem that works beautifully for repeat viewing because the escalation is simple, visual and impeccably timed.

title: Hair Love | Oscar®-Winning Short Film (Full) | Sony Pictures Animation
description: A warm, beautifully made short that gives children a polished story with emotional payoff while staying firmly family-safe.

title: Kitbull
description: A gorgeous, emotionally rich short best for slightly older children who can handle a tense beginning and appreciate its kindness-and-trust payoff.

title: Edible Crystal (3 ingredients)
description: A genuinely beautiful confection video that feels half recipe and half craft lesson, with a finished result kids find instantly enchanting.

title: How Japanese mochi sweets are made (Kibi dango)
description: A calm, exquisitely shot food-craft video that introduces children to a different confectionery tradition without any junky editing or noise.

title: Powers of Ten™ (1977)
description: A timeless classroom classic that still lands as a genuine mind-expander because it makes scale intuitive rather than abstract.

title: How Nerikiri confections are made | Japanese mother & daughter artisans
description: A superb culture-and-craft pick that shows children food as seasonal art, family tradition and patient hand-skill all at once.
